result.topic_en: Draft of a university lecture announcement (in Latin and German) for Riemann's private course on the mathematical theory of gravitation, magnetism and electricity and a public course on the method of least squares.
result.transcription:
Riemann 3
[-Professor-] Riemann, Dr. {+privatim+} theoriam gravitatis, magnetismi et electricitatis mathematicam
docebit. [-Hebd.-] Lun. Mart. {+Merc.+} [-Jov.-] & {+Jov.+} [-Ven.-] h. [-IX-]X[?]; [-Gratuitus-] {+publice+} methodum quadratorum minimorum
[-exponet-] binis scholis h. V-VI.
[-Prof. Riemann wird-] Die mathematische Theorie der Schwere, des Magnetismus und der Electricität
[-vortragen-] Mo. Dienst. Mittw. u. Donnerst. v. 9-10 Uhr; öffentlich Methode der kleinsten Quadrate zwei-
mal wöchentlich v. 5-6 Uhr.

items.quote:
{+privatim+} theoriam gravitatis, magnetismi et electricitatis mathematicam
docebit.
items.english: He will teach privately the mathematical theory of gravitation, magnetism and electricity.

items.quote:
{+publice+} methodum quadratorum minimorum
[-exponet-] binis scholis h. V-VI.
items.english: Publicly, (he will expound) the method of least squares in two lectures, at 5-6 o'clock.
